text:
Lena: quick Friday exec note — thanks for the hard work this sprint. Two main asks as we head into next week: 1) lock partner launch readiness (docs, runbooks, legal checklist) and 2) tighten cost/latency guardrails. Short updates below.

Oscar: on readiness I will own the partner checklist. Deliverable: finished checklist + signoffs by Tue 9am PT. Will validate SDK examples and migration notes.

Priya: product freeze starts Mon 00:00 PT for all non-critical UX changes. Any exceptions need CTO approval. Also drafting the one-pager migration summary for partners.

Rhea: SRE update 1: the retry storm from Wed was due to prewarm retries. Patch merged to throttle retries; deploying tonight. Adding circuit breaker to the prewarm client.

DevOps-bot: Deploy started at 1831234200 for svc-prewarm v2.2 to 25%.

DevOps-bot: Deploy status: 25m in, connection errors down 70%, p95 improved 10%.

Oscar: will run a 90-minute soak tomorrow. If clean we'll promote to 100%.

Sam: support readiness 1: playbook draft uploaded. Includes escalation matrix and top 7 troubleshooting steps. Will add cost-related FAQ by Mon.

Lena: policy change 1: starting next month code owners must approve infra config changes that affect latency or cost. Small teams have 48h review SLA. Priya to publish communications.

Priya: comms plan 1: knowledge base update, short partner email, and a 30-min partner webinar. Drafts in #marketing by Wed noon.

Lena: SLA proposal 1: two tiers — Enterprise SLA (p95 + uptime) and Standard SLO (best-effort + cost-aware routing). Oscar/Priya please draft customer-facing wording.

Rhea: routing fallback idea 1: primary -> Dedicated (region 1), fallback -> Hosted region 2, tertiary -> quantized variant with reduced context. We'll add an opt-in preserve-high-priority flag.

DevOps-bot: Canary test script:
- set CANARY=1
- route 5% traffic
- monitor p95,p99,error-rate
- rollback if errors >1%

DevOps-bot: Canary kicked off at 1831234500, weight=5%.

DevOps-bot: 35m update: p95=205ms, p99=560ms, errors=0.3% :thumbsup: 

Oscar: noted a low-frequency session-token race I will file as TICKET-789 and include a repro.

Lena: metrics to watch next week: 1) global p95 median 2) cost per 1M tokens. Auto-alert if p95 > baseline+15% or cost > baseline+8%.

Sam: finance snapshot: baseline cost/1M tokens = $47.5, current = $50.3 (6% increase).

Lena: thanks. Heads: post blockers here by Mon 6pm PT. We'll do a 20-min sync Tue 10:30 PT to finalize go/no-go. Appreciate everyone. :rocket:
